Name: NearbyChestHighlighter
Author: angrycoconut85
Description:
[size=4][b]
Full Description[/b]
[/size]Nearby Chest Highlighter is a Stardew Valley quality-of-life mod that helps you quickly find where an item is stored. Simply hover your mouse over an item in your inventory or menu, and the mod will highlight nearby chests that contain the same item.

Item matching ignores quality, so normal, silver, gold, and iridium-quality versions of the same item are treated as the same item. For performance reasons, the mod only checks chests within a limited range around the player instead of scanning every chest on the map.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Highlights matching nearby chests when you hover over an item.[/*]
[*]Detects chests that contain the same item.[/*]
[*]Ignores item quality when matching.[/*]
[*]Checks only a limited nearby range to reduce performance impact.[/*]
[*]Helps you quickly find where items are stored.[/*]
[*]Does not modify chest contents, capacity, or storage behavior.[/*]
[*]Pure quality-of-life improvement with no gameplay balance changes[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]完整描述[/size][/b]
Nearby Chest Highlighter 是一个 Stardew Valley 生活质量改进 Mod。使用时，只需要将鼠标移动到背包或菜单中的某个物品上，Mod 就会高亮显示玩家周围一定范围内、包含相同物品的箱子，方便你快速找到物品已经存放在哪个箱子里。

匹配时会忽略物品品质，也就是说普通、银星、金星和铱星品质的同类物品都会被视为相同物品。出于性能考虑，Mod 只会检测玩家周围一定范围内的箱子，不会扫描整个地图或所有地点。

[b][size=4]特性[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]将鼠标移动到物品上即可触发高亮。[/*]
[*]高亮玩家附近包含相同物品的箱子。[/*]
[*]匹配物品时忽略品质差异。[/*]
[*]只检测周围一定范围内的箱子，以减少性能影响。[/*]
[*]适合快速查找物品已存放的位置。[/*]
[*]不修改箱子内容、容量或物品管理逻辑。[/*]
[*]纯生活质量改进，不改变游戏平衡。[/*]
[/list]
